description_en: Queries detailed information of the workers specified by a job
description_zh: 获取任务指定的机器详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 read-schedulerx-designate-detail --job-id 368 --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id test.defalutGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --designate-type 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReadSchedulerxDesignateDetail

parameters.help_en: The job ID. You can obtain the ID on the Tasks page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，在控制台的任务管理页面中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier (UID) of the namespace. You can obtain the namespace UID on the Namespaces page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间UID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. You can obtain the application ID on the Applications page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The information type of the specified workers that you want to query. Valid values: 1 and 2.

1: the IP address of the specified workers.
2: the tags of the specified workers
parameters.help_zh:
指定机器的类型：
1：查询机器地址
2：查询机器标签
parameters.name: designate_type
